metadata.scope: Build the admin tag master code-edit UI 導線 (Issue #1116 = task-issue-1069-followup-001). The admin API PATCH /admin/tags/:tagId already accepts code/expectedCode and returns 409 tag_code_conflict (UNIQUE) vs 409 tag_stale_conflict (optimistic CAS) (delivered by issue-1069); apps/web has NO tag master CRUD edit page (apps/web has zero `expectedCode` references; `fetchTagMaster` is defined but unused outside tests). This workflow adds: (1) a NEW sibling admin route apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/tag-master/page.tsx (server component) that reads the tag master via the existing safeServerFetch('/admin/tags?...') surface; (2) NEW client components apps/web/src/features/admin/components/_tags/TagMasterPanel.tsx + TagMasterEditForm.tsx that list tags and edit code/label/category, holding the current code as expectedCode for compare-and-swap; (3) a NEW web API client apps/web/src/features/admin/api/tags.ts updateTag(tagId, {code?, label?, category?, expectedCode?}) that PATCHes /api/admin/tags/:tagId through the EXISTING catch-all proxy apps/web/app/api/admin/[...path]/route.ts and parses 409 tag_code_conflict vs tag_stale_conflict into separate display messages; (4) sidebar nav wiring in apps/web/src/components/shell/shell-config.ts (new ShellNavItemId 'tag-master', nav item /admin/tag-master label 'タグ管理') + apps/web/src/components/shell/icons.tsx (new 'tag-master' SVG path). Mutation runs through @/features/admin/hooks/useAdminMutation (invariant #10), inputs through FormField (invariant #9), colors via OKLch design tokens (invariant #2), and apps/web never touches the D1 binding (invariant #5). The CURRENT-CODE OPTIMIZATION over the stale issue: the issue assumed /admin/tags was free for tag master CRUD, but in current code /admin/tags is the tag QUEUE (shell-config.ts:82); a child route under /admin/tags/ would also activate the tag-queue nav item via isNavItemActive prefix matching, so a SIBLING route /admin/tag-master is required. Out of scope (already-scoped separate items, not new deferral): API rename implementation (issue-1069), tag physical delete / reactivate UI (issue-1070 API exists), member drawer inline-create UI (task-issue-1035-followup-001). This workflow now includes the local apps/web implementation and deterministic local evidence; commit, push, PR, staging deploy and authenticated visual capture remain user-gated. Issue #1116 is CLOSED; this workflow performs no Issue mutation (any future PR uses Refs #1116, never Closes).

metadata.issue_optimization_note: Issue #1116 (task-issue-1069-followup-001) was filed 2026-06-03 against a snapshot where it assumed admin tag master would live at /admin/tags and that 'admin tag master 専用 CRUD ページがまだ無い'. Re-checked against the CURRENT codebase (HEAD = origin/dev d2c7124b0, 2026-06-06): (a) the tag master code-edit UI is STILL unimplemented — `rg expectedCode apps/web` returns 0 hits and `fetchTagMaster`/`fetchAllTagMaster` (apps/web/src/features/admin/api/members.ts) are unused outside tests, so this task is genuinely needed; (b) the route assumption is STALE — /admin/tags is now the tag QUEUE page (apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/tags/page.tsx, nav id 'tag-queue' shell-config.ts:82), so the master CRUD must use a NEW sibling route /admin/tag-master, NOT a child of /admin/tags (isNavItemActive uses `pathname.startsWith(href + '/')`, so /admin/tags/master would keep the tag-queue item active — a real nav-collision bug avoided by the sibling route); (c) the API surface has GROWN since the issue — PATCH code/expectedCode (issue-1069) plus reactivate/physical-delete (issue-1070) all exist, but per the issue scope this UI task is scoped to list + code/label/category edit + conflict display only (create lives in MemberTagInlineCreate, delete/reactivate are separate). The web proxy needs NO new route: apps/web/app/api/admin/[...path]/route.ts already forwards PATCH /api/admin/tags/:tagId. Optimization recorded as spec_creation_strategy=optimize_to_current_codebase.
